# Code of Conduct

MyReader aims to maintain a respectful, welcoming community focused on collaboration. Follow these principles when participating in issues, discussions, pull requests, or other project spaces.

## Expected Behavior

- Respect differences in experience, background, language, and perspective.
- Discuss facts, code, and user impact without attacking individuals.
- Give actionable, good-faith feedback that stays relevant to the topic.
- Respect privacy, copyright, and security-disclosure boundaries.
- Acknowledge and correct mistakes, then continue collaborating.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, discrimination, threats, humiliation, or persistent personal attacks.
- Publishing another person's private information without consent.
- Posting sexual, violent, or other offensive material unrelated to the project.
- Spam, deliberate disruption, or continued interference after being asked to stop.
- Using project channels to distribute pirated books, credentials, or unlawful data.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may edit, hide, or remove content that violates this code and may issue a warning, temporary restriction, or permanent ban depending on severity.

To report a conduct issue privately, email [wenslife@outlook.com](mailto:wenslife@outlook.com). Include relevant links and necessary context. Reports will be handled confidentially within reasonable limits.
